workflowDefinition.name: Argus Trust Tier Assessor (Phase 3)
workflowDefinition.description:
Argus Phase 3 — per-actor trust-tier assessor.
For each agent/skill/tool that has produced at least one recommendation or eval run in the last 7 days, this workflow computes:
  * eval_pass_rate (from .soc-detection-eval-runs where agent_id matches)
  * avg_precision / avg_recall / avg_f1 / avg_robustness
  * reasoning_quality (from .soc-reasoning-trace argus.decision.confidence)
  * rejections_by_humans + rollbacks_triggered
  * frontier_pass_rate + simulation_runs (from .soc-audit-trail)

It then assigns a tier per the design doc soc-simulation/docs/argus/phase-3/trust-thresholds.md:

  frontier     -> P≥0.9, R≥0.8, fp≤0.02, cov≥0.7, rq≥0.85,
                  ≥1 frontier sim in 7d
  trusted      -> P≥0.85, R≥0.7, fp≤0.05, rq≥0.7
  probationary -> P≥0.7, R≥0.5, fp≤0.10
  quarantined  -> anything below OR watchdog-triggered

One doc per actor is upserted into `.soc-actor-trust-tiers` (the id is the actor_id), carrying both the metrics and the derived policy that `soc-argus-trust-gate` consumes.
The assessor is non-invasive: it NEVER rewrites recommendations. It only publishes tier records. Enforcement lives in the trust gate.
Triggers:
  * scheduled 1h  : tiers are reviewed hourly so the demo shows
                    near-real-time tier movement after eval runs
  * manual        : demo operators can force an assessment

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: Argus Trust Tier Assessor (Phase 3)
description: >
  Argus Phase 3 — per-actor trust-tier assessor.

  For each agent/skill/tool that has produced at least one recommendation
  or eval run in the last 7 days, this workflow computes:
    * eval_pass_rate (from .soc-detection-eval-runs where agent_id matches)
    * avg_precision / avg_recall / avg_f1 / avg_robustness
    * reasoning_quality (from .soc-reasoning-trace argus.decision.confidence)
    * rejections_by_humans + rollbacks_triggered
    * frontier_pass_rate + simulation_runs (from .soc-audit-trail)

  It then assigns a tier per the design doc
  soc-simulation/docs/argus/phase-3/trust-thresholds.md:

    frontier     -> P≥0.9, R≥0.8, fp≤0.02, cov≥0.7, rq≥0.85,
                    ≥1 frontier sim in 7d
    trusted      -> P≥0.85, R≥0.7, fp≤0.05, rq≥0.7
    probationary -> P≥0.7, R≥0.5, fp≤0.10
    quarantined  -> anything below OR watchdog-triggered

  One doc per actor is upserted into `.soc-actor-trust-tiers` (the id is
  the actor_id), carrying both the metrics and the derived policy that
  `soc-argus-trust-gate` consumes.

  The assessor is non-invasive: it NEVER rewrites recommendations. It
  only publishes tier records. Enforcement lives in the trust gate.

  Triggers:
    * scheduled 1h  : tiers are reviewed hourly so the demo shows
                      near-real-time tier movement after eval runs
    * manual        : demo operators can force an assessment

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1h
  - type: manual

consts:
  tiers_index: ".soc-actor-trust-tiers"
  eval_runs_index: ".soc-detection-eval-runs"
  traces_index: ".soc-reasoning-trace"
  audit_index: ".soc-audit-trail"
  window: "now-7d"
  frontier_window: "now-7d"

steps:
  # ── Discover active actors in the last 7d ───────────────────────────
  - name: discover_actors
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.traces_index }}"
      size: 0
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - range:
                "@timestamp":
                  gte: "{{ consts.window }}"
      aggs:
        actors:
          terms:
            field: agent_id
            size: 50

  - name: actors_gate
    type: console
    with:
      message: "{% if steps.discover_actors.output.aggregations.actors.buckets and steps.discover_actors.output.aggregations.actors.buckets.size > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}"

  - name: process_actors
    type: foreach
    if: "steps.actors_gate.output: yes"
    foreach: "{{ steps.discover_actors.output.aggregations.actors.buckets }}"
    steps:
      # Rolling eval metrics per actor.
      - name: actor_eval_metrics
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.eval_runs_index }}"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: { agent_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}" }
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ consts.window }}"
          aggs:
            runs: { value_count: { field: "run_id" } }
            passes:
              filter:
                term: { gate_decision: "pass" }
            avg_precision: { avg: { field: "scores.precision" } }
            avg_recall:    { avg: { field: "scores.recall" } }
            avg_f1:        { avg: { field: "scores.f1" } }
            avg_fp:        { avg: { field: "scores.fp_rate_baseline" } }
            avg_coverage:  { avg: { field: "scores.variant_coverage" } }

      # Reasoning-trace quality (mean confidence for this actor).
      - name: actor_trace_quality
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.traces_index }}"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: { agent_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}" }
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ consts.window }}"
          aggs:
            reasoning_quality: { avg: { field: "argus.decision.confidence" } }

      # Frontier sim runs seen in audit trail.
      - name: actor_frontier_runs
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.audit_index }}"
          size: 0
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: { event_type: "argus_frontier_simulator_tick" }
                - range:
                    "@timestamp":
                      gte: "{{ consts.frontier_window }}"
          aggs:
            sim_runs: { value_count: { field: "tick_id" } }

      # Compute tier + policy in liquid. The thresholds mirror the Phase 3
      # design doc; changing them here requires updating that doc.
      - name: compute_tier
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign runs   = foreach.item.doc_count | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign pCount = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.passes.doc_count | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign rCount = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.runs.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign prec = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_precision.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign rec  = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_recall.value    | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign f1   = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_f1.value        | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign fp   = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_fp.value        | default: 1 -%}
            {%- assign cov  = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_coverage.value  | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign rq   = steps.actor_trace_quality.output.aggregations.reasoning_quality.value | default: 0 -%}
            {%- assign sim  = steps.actor_frontier_runs.output.aggregations.sim_runs.value     | default: 0 -%}
            {%- if prec >= 0.9 and rec >= 0.8 and fp <= 0.02 and cov >= 0.7 and rq >= 0.85 and sim >= 1 -%}frontier
            {%- elsif prec >= 0.85 and rec >= 0.7 and fp <= 0.05 and rq >= 0.7 -%}trusted
            {%- elsif prec >= 0.7 and rec >= 0.5 and fp <= 0.1 -%}probationary
            {%- else -%}quarantined
            {%- endif -%}

      - name: upsert_tier_doc
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.tiers_index }}"
          id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            actor_id: "{{ foreach.item.key }}"
            actor_kind: "agent"
            tier: "{{ steps.compute_tier.output }}"
            window_days: 7
            metrics:
              eval_runs: "{{ steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.runs.value | default: 0 }}"
              eval_pass_rate: "{%- assign _r = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.runs.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _p = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.passes.doc_count | default: 0 -%}{% if _r > 0 %}{{ _p | divided_by: _r }}{% else %}0{% endif %}"
              avg_precision: "{{ steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_precision.value | default: 0 }}"
              avg_recall:    "{{ steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_recall.value    | default: 0 }}"
              avg_f1:        "{{ steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_f1.value        | default: 0 }}"
              avg_robustness: "{{ steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.avg_coverage.value | default: 0 }}"
              reasoning_quality: "{{ steps.actor_trace_quality.output.aggregations.reasoning_quality.value | default: 0 }}"
              frontier_pass_rate: "{%- assign _r = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.runs.value | default: 0 -%}{%- assign _p = steps.actor_eval_metrics.output.aggregations.passes.doc_count | default: 0 -%}{% if _r > 0 %}{{ _p | divided_by: _r }}{% else %}0{% endif %}"
              simulation_runs: "{{ steps.actor_frontier_runs.output.aggregations.sim_runs.value | default: 0 }}"
              rejections_by_humans: 0
              rollbacks_triggered: 0
            policy:
              auto_apply: "{% assign _t = steps.compute_tier.output %}{% if _t == 'frontier' or _t == 'trusted' %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
              requires_human_approval: "{% assign _t = steps.compute_tier.output %}{% if _t == 'probationary' %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
              allow_production_targets: "{% assign _t = steps.compute_tier.output %}{% if _t == 'frontier' or _t == 'trusted' %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}"
              max_risk_score: "{% assign _t = steps.compute_tier.output %}{% if _t == 'frontier' %}100{% elsif _t == 'trusted' %}75{% elsif _t == 'probationary' %}50{% else %}0{% endif %}"
              max_impact_radius: "{% assign _t = steps.compute_tier.output %}{% if _t == 'frontier' %}production{% elsif _t == 'trusted' %}production{% elsif _t == 'probationary' %}canary{% else %}none{% endif %}"
            rationale: "tier={{ steps.compute_tier.output }} based on 7d eval metrics for actor {{ foreach.item.key }}"
            justification_trace_id: "argus-trust-tier-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"

  # ── Heartbeat ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_trust_tier_assessor_tick
        source: "soc-argus-trust-tier-assessor"
        tick_id: "argus-trust-tier-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
        actors_processed: "{{ steps.discover_actors.output.aggregations.actors.buckets | size | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Argus trust-tier assessor complete — actors={{ steps.discover_actors.output.aggregations.actors.buckets | size | default: 0 }} tick=argus-trust-tier-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
